sources.title: GitHub - githigher/MASH: Official implementation of "MASH: Evading ...
sources.snippet: MASH is a multi-stage black-box attack framework that reformulates detector evasion as a style transfer task. It trains a lightweight BART-based paraphraser (∼0.1B parameters) through a sequential pipeline—Style-injection SFT, DPO alignment, and inference-time refinement—to transform AI-generated text into human-like text that evades both open-source and commercial detectors.

sources.snippet: Alternatively mash_model_new_from_file () can be used as a convenience wrapper to easily make an actor out of a PLY without having to worry about MashData. To share the data with another actor, call mash_model_get_data () on an existing actor then call mash_model_set_data () with the return value on a new actor.
